This violates contract constraint milvus_range_collections_create_002 (shardsNum >= 1) and represents a cross-channel validation inconsistency (REST v2 weaker than gRPC), which maintainers historically treat as defects per developer_cognition.json blindspot 'REST v2 and gRPC divergent validation'.
